decision: One live assistant session, plus short probes for the other backends
why: A second long-lived session would write the same event stream and break the one-process shutdown path. A static catalog cannot tell a failed launch from an empty account.

decision: Drop a backend from the menu when its report is empty or the probe fails
why: An inert placeholder looks like a model the owner can pick. Omitting it matches the old empty picker.

decision: Keep reported models for the life of the coordinator, with no timer
why: A timer would hide a backend the owner already saw and start another process for the same answer.

decision: Probe deadline is 15 seconds
why: Claude's model query can take about 10 seconds. A shorter deadline would record a slow answer as unavailable.

decision: Settings and the model menu share one apply path
why: Two restart paths could shut down twice or leave the turn running. The shared path shuts the turn down before the next session.

decision: set_model waits for the new session's own model list and for idle model settings
why: Sending set_model to the old process, or before the list arrives, can select the wrong id or drop the pick.

decision: A non-empty transcript gets one notice. The old conversation is not replayed.
why: The next backend starts its own session. Replaying the transcript would invent history that backend never had.

decision: Apple Foundation Models are a seeded row on Mac and are not probed. GTK never lists them.
why: The on-device model is fixed and only the Mac app can run it. GTK plan_launch already fails closed for apple-fm.

decision: Direct Codex and Grok stay hidden. They remain reachable only through pi.
why: v1.1.0 hid those adapters. The flag stays false and their code stays.

decision: Reverted a crate-wide rustfmt that wrapped accessibility calls
why: The accessibility scanner requires a11y(& on one line. Formatting the whole crate broke that and drowned the review.

decision: Linux catalog tests passed, including the live probe and the mid-turn idle test
why: The GTK coordinator is what Linux and Windows both run.
result: 15 passed, probe passed, idle test passed

decision: Swift tests were not executed in this environment
why: The workspace has no Swift toolchain and no Mac. The Mac source contract was checked by reading the files.

decision: The committed diff is the catalog change, not a crate-wide format
why: The earlier rustfmt row pointed at an uncommitted diff. This commit range is the reviewable change.

decision: A catalog probe sets PITEX_CATALOG_PROBE so Claude does not persist a project session
why: Listing models was starting a real Claude session in the project. The real conversation still persists. The probe does not.

decision: A model the new session does not list is dropped, and the menu stops showing it
why: The pick is sent only when that session lists the same id and provider. Leaving the old label selected would claim a model that was never sent.

decision: The catalog test filter does not run the short-lived probe. That probe was run on its own.
why: The earlier verify row grouped the probe under the catalog filter. The probe name has no catalog in it.

decision: Unchecking the live backend, mid-turn or idle, switches to the first remaining offered backend through the existing shutdown and restart. Unchecking the last one stops the session and leaves the menu empty.
why: One rule covers both states. A running turn still has to return to idle, which the existing shutdown already does.

decision: Every offered backend may be unchecked. The last checkbox is not pinned.
why: The catalog is a filter over backends the owner wants. An empty filter is a valid filter.
evidence: SessionPlan::Stop when the enabled list is empty and a session is open

decision: A missing ai.disabledBackends means every offered backend stays enabled. The stored ai.agentProvider remains the live session.
why: The catalog the owner just got must not shrink on upgrade, and a missing key needs no rewrite.
evidence: DisabledBackends.parse treats a missing value as an empty denylist

decision: A disabled backend is not probed. Re-enabling it starts the existing probe only when it is not the live session.
why: A probe exists to fill a row the owner can pick. A hidden backend has no row.
evidence: reconcile_enablement drops slots and stops probes outside the enabled set

decision: Settings checkboxes and the model menu read the same slots, which are the offered backends minus ai.disabledBackends. Only the coordinator writes ai.agentProvider.
why: Two keys are two facts, membership and the live session. One writer keeps the session key from drifting away from the menu.
evidence: The Settings dropdown and SelectionIntent::Backend were removed

decision: Rechecking the stored backend after every box was cleared starts that session again when the panel already wants a connection.
why: The stored id is still the session, so the plan is keep, and keep does not restart. The panel would stay empty.
evidence: agent.rs reconcile_enablement calls prepare when the idle flag clears onto the stored backend
